name: Python
content: I am proficient in Python and have used it extensively for ETL pipelines, data analysis, machine learning, and deep learning projects. I am familiar with libraries like NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.

name: SQL & BigQuery
content: I have extensive experience with SQL across Google BigQuery, MS SQL Server, and MySQL. I have written optimized queries to transform 10M+ monthly records and developed stored procedures for role-based data access.

name: Machine Learning
content: I have strong expertise in machine learning including classification, regression, clustering, and ensemble methods. I have built production models using XGBoost, Random Forest, Scikit-Learn, and applied SHAP for model interpretability.

name: Deep Learning
content: I have hands-on experience with deep learning using PyTorch and TensorFlow/Keras. I have fine-tuned transformer models (ModernBERT, Gemma-2-2B) using LoRA and 4-bit quantization for NLP tasks.

name: Natural Language Processing
content: I have worked on NLP projects including multilabel text classification, sentiment analysis, and transformer fine-tuning. I am familiar with HuggingFace, spaCy, and vLLM for model deployment with constrained decoding.

name: PySpark
content: I have used PySpark to develop large-scale data processing pipelines and ETL workflows. I have built Airflow DAGs in PySpark to automate data flows and reduce manual processing time by over 80%.

name: Airflow
content: I have used Apache Airflow to orchestrate and automate data pipelines. I designed and deployed DAGs that streamlined ETL workflows and reduced reporting refresh times from 24 hours to under 2 hours.

name: Pandas & NumPy
content: I am highly proficient in Pandas and NumPy for data wrangling, feature engineering, and statistical analysis. I have used these extensively across professional and academic data science projects.

name: XGBoost
content: I have used XGBoost for credit risk modeling, achieving AUC ~0.95 on a 5.5M-row dataset. I applied Grid Search (72+ configurations) for hyperparameter tuning and SHAP for interpretability.

name: Power BI & Tableau
content: I have built interactive dashboards in Power BI with drill-down tiles for workforce analytics. I have also used Tableau for consumer insights and data visualization in academic projects.

name: Statistics & A/B Testing
content: I have applied statistical methods including hypothesis testing, regression analysis, LASSO, and causal analytics. I have experience with A/B testing frameworks and SciPy for statistical computations.

name: PyTorch
content: I have used PyTorch for deep learning model development, including transformer fine-tuning with LoRA, gradient checkpointing, and 4-bit quantization for efficient training on limited GPU resources.

name: Scikit-Learn
content: I am proficient in Scikit-Learn for building ML pipelines, preprocessing, model selection, and evaluation. I have used it extensively for classification, regression, and clustering tasks.

name: Matplotlib & SciPy
content: I use Matplotlib and SciPy for data visualization and scientific computing. I have applied these tools for EDA, statistical testing, and presenting insights from large datasets.
